title: More wmem_packet_scope cleanup
description: Several commits that clean up wmem_packet_scope usage.  Broken up by how invasive the changes were (and if they sparked other code cleanup changes)

notes.body:
added 6 commits
  • 6ac1a5c6 - packet-gluster: wmem_packet_scope -> pinfo->pool
  • 7724ccda - bluetooth: wmem_packet_scope -> pinfo->pool
  • 4cd21d40 - packet-cip.c: wmem_packet_scope() -> pinfo->pool
  • e8120e4b - packet-dplay: Code cleanup
  • 6e8fa6f7 - packet-giop: get_CDR_string now requires scope allocation
  • 01931e0d - Assorted wmem_packet_scope cleanup

changes_data.diff:
@@ -364,9 +364,8 @@ WS_DLL_PUBLIC void giop_add_CDR_string(proto_tree *tree, tvbuff_t *tvb, int *off
  * boundary for string values. (begins with an unsigned long LI)
  *
  * String sequence is copied to a buffer "seq".
- * Memory is allocated in packet pool and will be
- * automatically freed once the packet dissection is finished.
- * offset is then incremented  , to indicate the  octets which
+ * Memory is allocated in scope pool and will be automatically freed.
+ * offset is then incremented, to indicate the octets which
  * have been processed.
  *
  * returns number of octets in the sequence
@@ -376,7 +375,7 @@ WS_DLL_PUBLIC void giop_add_CDR_string(proto_tree *tree, tvbuff_t *tvb, int *off
  *
  */
 
-WS_DLL_PUBLIC uint32_t get_CDR_string(tvbuff_t *tvb, const char **seq, int *offset,

     bool stream_is_big_endian, int boundary);

commits_data.title: packet-giop: get_CDR_string now requires scope allocation
commits_data.message:
packet-giop: get_CDR_string now requires scope allocation

It moves the need for wmem_packet_scope() up one layer to giop_add_CDR_string.  giop_add_CDR_string is used by generated dissectors so it will be handled in a future patch.

packet_info* is now more prevalent in dissection functions.

commits_data.title: packet-dplay: Code cleanup
commits_data.message:
packet-dplay: Code cleanup

1. Use display_unicode_string from packet-smb-common.c instead of rewrite.  Update it for modern APIs
2. Use proto_tree_add_item_ret_uint more frequently
3. Add a few more proto_tree_add_bitmask modify the hf_ field data accordingly

commits_data.title: packet-cip.c: wmem_packet_scope() -> pinfo->pool
commits_data.message:
packet-cip.c: wmem_packet_scope() -> pinfo->pool

Also address mismatched hf_ field value

commits_data.title: packet-gluster: wmem_packet_scope -> pinfo->pool
commits_data.message:
packet-gluster: wmem_packet_scope -> pinfo->pool

packet_info* is now used a lot more ;)

commits_data.title: packet-e164: wmem_packet_scope() -> pinfo->pool and handle fallout
commits_data.message:
packet-e164: wmem_packet_scope() -> pinfo->pool and handle fallout

Several calls were tried to needing packet_info* to make the wmem_packet_scope transition, so adjust as necessary.

commits_data.title: GBCS: Code cleanup
commits_data.message:
GBCS: Code cleanup

1. Replace wmem_packet_scope() with pinfo->pool, but also remove "low layer APIs" to display values one layer up the tree.
2. Cache message data value for faster compare
